About bluCognition

bluCognition is an AI-powered commercial credit intelligence company serving lenders and financial institutions. Our platform combines commercial credit data contributed by 150+ lenders with AI-driven analytics, banking data and fraud detection to help our clients make faster, better credit decisions. Our product suite includes bluSense, which converts bank statements into standardized, categorized transaction data with real-time financial insights, and FraudLens, which detects document tampering and first-party fraud. Alongside our data products, we run a managed services business supporting underwriting, fraud review, and KYC/KYB and sanctions screening operations for our clients, with teams across North America, Asia and Europe.

About the Role

We are looking for an Analyst / Senior Analyst – Credit Risk to support credit underwriting and risk consulting engagements. The role will involve financial analysis, credit assessment, underwriting execution and research, with responsibility for accurately evaluating financial and business information and supporting credit decisions. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of financial statements, good analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively with structured and unstructured financial information.

• Analyze financial statements, bank statements, tax documents, AR/AP aging and other business/financial documents to assess the financial position and creditworthiness of entities.

• Conduct business and industry research, including verification of entity information and identification of relevant business or credit risks.
• Review supporting documentation, including commercial contracts, to identify inconsistencies, key terms and potential credit risks.
• Manage assigned underwriting cases and queues, ensuring accuracy, quality and adherence to client SLAs and processes.
• Maintain trackers, MIS and other process documentation, and support SOP, process improvement and automation initiatives.

• 1-3 years of experience in credit risk, commercial credit underwriting, financial analysis or financial services; experience with US, Canada or LATAM markets preferred.
• Strong understanding of financial statements, ratio analysis, cash flow, working capital and credit fundamentals, with the ability to assess a company's financial position.
• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to work with large volumes of financial and business information.
• Good understanding of MS Excel, including financial analysis and data handling.
• Strong written & verbal communication skills and ability to work effectively with stakeholders.
• Ability to work in a structured, deadline-driven environment & adapt across multiple client processes / requirements.

Educational Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Economics, Business or a related discipline.
• MBA / M.Com / CA Inter / Semi-qualified CA or equivalent qualification is preferred.
• Relevant credit risk/underwriting experience will be considered in lieu of additional qualifications.

Registration Arena is India’s leading online professional services platform for business registration, IPRs, accounting, auditing and taxation backed by a team of over 20+ top-notch professionals based in Pune, India. Why Join Us? – What’s in It for You
• Time Off: Last Saturdays off every month.
• Work Environment: Informal dress code and a positive, growth-driven atmosphere.
• Training and Development: Regular In-house Training Sessions: Focused related areas Fast-paced Learning Curve and Mentorship

• Team Culture: Collaborative and supportive work environment that values creativity, innovation, and mutual respect.
• Leadership: Approachable management with open communication.
• Celebrations: Team events for milestones, birthdays, and achievements.
• Friendly and Professional Work Environment: Supportive seniors, open culture, and collaborative team
• Professional Growth: Hands-on exposure to Accounting, Auditing, and Taxation work across diverse industries.

• Accounting & Bookkeeping: Perform monthly accounting tasks and review books of accounts for accuracy and completeness.

• Tax Filing: Manage GST, TDS, Professional Tax, and Income Tax return filings.

• Technical Skills: Proficiency in Tally, Advanced Excel, and accounting software.
• Knowledge: Strong understanding of taxation laws, GST, TDS, PT, Ind AS, and corporate taxation.
• Soft Skills: Analytical mindset, detail-oriented, strong communication, and organizational ability.
• Preference: Local candidates; in-person interviews preferred.
• Fluent in English with good communication skills
• Punctual, professional, and responsible

Ways to Stand Out:
• Display genuine interest in accounting, taxation, and compliance.
• Be proactive and take ownership of assignments.
• Show strong client handling and deadline management skills.
• Maintain professionalism, discipline, and team spirit.
• Demonstrate eagerness to learn and adapt to complex assignments.

If you are an experienced accountant looking to accelerate your career with real-world exposure, diverse assignments, and professional mentorship, we would love to hear from you. Please share your resume on hr@registrationarena.com

Title and Summary

Senior Analyst, Risk Management

Senior Analyst, IT Risk Management – Individual Contributor

Overview

The Senior Analyst, IT Risk Management, will support our SOX Compliance program within the Finance Organization and will report into the US-based Manager, Risk Management. This position will primarily focus on scoping and evaluation of general and application IT controls. The Senior Analyst will be responsible for managing and executing various aspects of the program including IT scoping, delivery of the program, and reporting of results. The Senior Analyst will work closely with the US-based SOX team, worldwide IT departments, regional controllership, our shared services center, business owners, and our internal and external auditors, with the expectation of some overlap in the working hours.

Requirements for this position include extensive knowledge of IT general and application controls, strong understanding of IT control frameworks (e.g., COBIT, NIST Cybersecurity, NIST SP 800-53, CIS/SANS Top 20), familiarity with SEC/PCAOB regulations, COSO and US GAAP, as well as the demonstrated ability to monitor an effective global risk-based IT control environment.

• Are you looking to join a fast-paced, collaborative environment supporting a world class growing organization?
• Do you have the ability to think strategically and execute a complex project?
• Do you have a risk-based mindset?
• Are you IT savvy?
• Do you have the ability to drive change and improve awareness across the organization?

Role

Job Description
• Support the execution of various SOX program components, including IT scoping, IT risk assessment, training of stakeholders on IT control-related best practices, IT control testing and review, remediation recommendations, deficiency evaluations and reporting
• Report to a US-based Manager, Risk Management
• Assess and determine design effectiveness of internal controls
• Experience covering multiple technology environments such as Mainframe, UNIX/Linux, Cloud and Windows environments
• Work with business owners to address any potential control gaps that may require remediation
• Partner with various business owners and IT teams including technology compliance, operations, development, and application support to provide expertise in assessing the design and effectiveness of IT controls
• Liaise with regional finance and IT stakeholders as well as internal and external auditors
• Ensure the delivery of high quality, timely work products
• Continuously identify efficiencies in the SOX program and opportunities for optimization of the financial and operational processes and controls through interaction and partnership with management
• Exhibit strong project management skills with the ability to hold self and others accountable to internal and external deadlines
• Ability to effectively manage international time-zone differences in communication globally
• Demonstrate the ability to exercise judgment and display a high standard of ethics and professionalism
• Demonstrate exceptional communications skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to understand complexities of the business

All About You
• Bachelor Degree Accounting, Business, Management Information Systems or equivalent, a CPA/CA, CISA or similar certification required
• Has a strong understanding of IT control concepts and framework such as COBIT, NIST Cybersecurity, NIST SP 800-53, CIS/SANS Top 20, Sarbanes Oxley, COSO, and leading business practices
• Recent experience providing IT auditing or IT advisory-type services
• Knowledge of best practices around IT controls
• Working knowledge of current PCAOB Auditing and Accounting Standards
• Experience with the IT external audit or risk advisory services or an in-house Technology Risk Management (first/second line of defense) or equivalent experience in a large, regulated organization with exposure to both infrastructure and applications
• Knowledge of common enterprise and web application technologies
• Familiarity with audit automation preferred
• Proven ability to manage complex engagements or programs
• Excellent oral and written communication skills and interpersonal skills with emphasis on building strong, longer-term relationships worldwide across varying geographies and functions

• Strong analytic, logical reasoning and problem-solving skills
• Strong project management skills to lead and prioritize multiple projects

• Some travel may be required in the future, up to 10% travel

• Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

• Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

• Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

• Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

EY GDS - Delivery Excellence Senior position

Within last decade, cost of delivery and Delivery excellence has become the most critical factors to run successful and popular businesses spread around the globe. To support such a dynamic and fast paced IT transformation industry, we are using various cutting-edge Delivery Excellence models and tools with relentless focus on automation to offer best in class and tailor-made solutions to our clients.

As a part of our global team you will be part of GDS projects as Delivery Excellence management professional. You will be involved in working on challenging problems and creating next generation delivery excellence platforms.

The opportunity

Are you a detail driven professional with a passion for translating business needs into impactful product experiences? Do you thrive at the intersection of people, process, and technology? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join our Product team and help shape solutions that deliver real value to our clients and users.

In this role, you’ll serve as a critical bridge between the business stakeholders and the development and engineering teams. Your work will influence how ideas become features, how features become products, and how products deliver meaningful outcomes in a fast paced, evolving environment.

As a key member of the Product team, you will play a hands on role in defining business requirements, crafting user stories, and ensuring that technical execution aligns seamlessly with business objectives. You will lead user acceptance testing (UAT), drive iterative testing cycles, validate enhancements, and ensure that issues or defects are accurately identified, tracked, and resolved. Your keen eye for detail and strong communication skills will help ensure that every release meets the highest standards of quality and functionality.

This is a client facing and user centric role where you will engage with stakeholders, address queries, clarify requirements, and ensure that feedback is incorporated into continuous product improvements. You’ll gain a deep understanding of real world user behaviors, business processes, and product journeys—making this the perfect place to grow as a product focused business professional while driving meaningful impact across the product lifecycle.

If you’re energized by the opportunity to influence product development end to end, collaborate with cross functional teams, and help bring scalable, user friendly solutions to life, this role provides the platform for you to make a lasting difference.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements, ensuring alignment across stakeholders, product managers, and engineering teams.
• Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by testing the defined test cases, validating functionality, and ensuring readiness for release.
• Support in iterative testing cycles, identifying defects, documenting issues, validating fixes, and performing regression testing as needed.
• Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
• Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
• Serve as one of the primary liaison between business teams and engineering, providing clarifications, resolving requirement gaps, and ensuring shared understanding throughout the product lifecycle.
• Review and validate bug fixes, ensuring that resolved issues meet expected outcomes before closure.
• Engage with clients and end users, addressing queries, troubleshooting issues, and gathering feedback for continuous improvement.
• Support product rollout activities, including release planning, communication, and training support where required.
• Monitor product performance post release, identify enhancement opportunities, and contribute to backlog prioritization.
• Maintain comprehensive documentation including requirement specifications, UAT plans, test results, and user feedback logs.
• Support product strategy, roadmap planning, and end-to-end product lifecycle management for Internal Controls and Audit solutions.
• Partner with stakeholders across business, risk, audit, and technology teams to gather requirements and drive product adoption.
• Own MIS, reporting, KPI tracking, and executive dashboards to measure product performance and business outcomes.
• Analyse large datasets to derive insights, identify control gaps, and support decision-making.
• Drive product implementation, rollout, user onboarding, and change management initiatives.
• Collaborate with engineering teams to define functional requirements and prioritise product backlogs.
• Identify automation and AI opportunities to enhance audit and internal control processes.

Skills And Attributes For Success

• Risk Assessment – Assessment of internal processes to identify findings, vulnerabilities, and control gaps/deviations identified across applications and infrastructure.
• Control Monitoring / Testing - Understanding of controls around Business processes, ITGC, Cyber, Data protection and privacy to perform testing of design and operational effectiveness of controls.

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Chartered Accountant to lead our Finance & Accounts function. The Accounts & Finance Manager will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of accounting, financial reporting, taxation, budgeting, treasury, statutory compliance, audits, and internal controls. - Review general ledger balances and perform account reconciliations.
- Monitor fixed assets, depreciation schedules, and capital expenditure accounting.
- Ensure timely month-end and year-end closing activities.

2. Taxation & Statutory Compliance

- Ensure complete compliance with GST, TDS, Income Tax, Professional Tax, and other applicable statutory regulations.
- Review and file GST returns, TDS returns, Income Tax returns, and other statutory filings within prescribed timelines.
- Handle tax assessments, departmental notices, and litigation support.
- Coordinate with tax consultants and legal advisors for compliance and advisory matters.
- Monitor changes in tax laws and assess their impact on the organization.
- Ensure timely payment of statutory dues and maintain proper documentation.

3. Audit & Internal Controls

- Lead statutory audits, internal audits, tax audits, and cost audits.
- Coordinate with external auditors and ensure timely completion of audits.
- Implement recommendations arising from audit findings.
- Develop and strengthen internal financial controls and SOPs.
- Ensure compliance with company policies and statutory requirements.
- Conduct periodic financial risk assessments and recommend mitigation measures.

4. Budgeting, Forecasting & Financial Planning

- Prepare annual operating budgets in consultation with department heads.
- Develop monthly and quarterly financial forecasts.
- Analyze budget versus actual performance and provide variance analysis.
- Support strategic financial planning and long-term business forecasting.
- Recommend cost optimization and profitability improvement initiatives.

5. Treasury & Cash Flow Management

- Monitor daily cash flow and liquidity requirements.
- Manage banking relationships and oversee fund management activities.
- Prepare cash flow forecasts and optimize working capital.
- Coordinate loan documentation, banking facilities, and financial instruments.
- Ensure efficient utilization of available funds.

6. MIS & Financial Analysis

- Prepare monthly MIS reports for senior management.
- Develop dashboards and KPI reports for business performance monitoring.
- Analyze profitability, margins, operating costs, and financial trends.
- Present financial insights to support strategic decision-making.
- Identify opportunities for revenue enhancement and cost reduction.

7. Accounts Payable & Receivable

- Monitor vendor payments and ensure timely settlement.
- Review customer receivables and coordinate collection activities.
- Ensure proper reconciliation of customer and vendor accounts.
- Improve receivable cycles and reduce outstanding balances.

8. ERP & Process Improvement

- Ensure effective utilization of ERP systems for finance operations.
- Participate in ERP implementation, upgrades, and process automation initiatives.
- Improve accounting processes through digitization and automation.
- Develop standardized financial procedures across business functions.

9. Team Management

- Lead, supervise, and mentor the finance and accounts team.
- Allocate responsibilities and monitor team performance.
- Conduct regular performance reviews and training sessions.
- Foster a culture of accuracy, accountability, and continuous improvement.

10. Business Support

- Provide financial support for new projects, investments, and expansion initiatives.
- Conduct financial feasibility studies and investment analysis.
- Support management during mergers, acquisitions, fundraising, or due diligence activities.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve operational efficiency.

- Chartered Accountant (CA) .

The Analyst supports month-end closes processes for our division partners and manages the calculation, payment and accounting for various distributor incentives. This position also provides reporting on department performance including accounts receivable aging and executes monthly processing controls to ensure accuracy. This position involves regular interaction with distributors, division finance and Ecolab sales management teams.

• The support of an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives and ideas to achieve our best

What You Will Do:
• Provide month end reporting to multiple divisions summarizing Distributor Finance activity for processed resales, refunds, and handling fees
• Manage distributor incentive programs including tracking new and expired incentives, managing rebate accruals, and administering timely processing of rebate payments
• Administer key monthly controls including inventory trending analysis to validate accuracy of processing and quickly identify and resolve issues
• Provide distributor related accounts receivable analysis including weekly reporting, deduction review and account level reconciliations of debits and credits
• KPI reporting to ensure complete and accurate resale processing in SAP
• Evaluate potential improvements and scope expansion based on changing business needs
• Provide support, ad hoc reporting, and analysis to internal and external customers
• Ensure that all reporting processes and systems are documented
• Support various ad-hoc requests from Divisional partners
• Monthly/Quarterly risk reviews with Divisional partners
• Miscellaneous project support
